page.overview:
Who is Gordon?

He is seen along with Martin at the main door to the Great Hall of the castle and he announces the arrival of the Lords until he gets slammed by the door before he could finish.

He assists King Fergus into killing a bear in the castle unaware it is Queen Elinor until they were stopped by Princess Merida. He also attempted to attack Mor'du, but the giant bear proved to be too powerful for him. However, he survived like everyone else.
